Why this needs follow-up: The Anthropic Series H at $965B valuation with $518B in compute commitments is reported without named lead investors, confirmed closing, or dilution impact on GOOGL/AMZN's ~30% combined stake — all material facts for AI capex and hyperscaler positioning.

ANSWER EACH QUESTION (run a separate search for each):
- Has Anthropic officially confirmed the $65 billion Series H financing at a $965 billion post-money valuation reported on October 15 2026, and who are the named lead investors?
- What is the current confirmed ownership percentage of Google and Amazon in Anthropic after the Series H, and how does the $965 billion valuation affect the carrying value on their balance sheets?

Name every stock affected by this story with its move, analyst notes that name winners and losers
(firm, rating, PT), exact figures (deal values, estimates, dates), and the latest status as of the
cutoff. Prefer Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, company releases, filings.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or sub-topic:

## TICKER or Sub-topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

content:
## Anthropic [Series H / confirmation]

- Anthropic’s Series H was reported as a **$65 billion financing at a $965 billion post-money valuation**, with a stated closing date of **May 28, 2026**, not October 15, 2026; the available October 15 reports do not show a new official Anthropic release confirming terms during the requested window. [report] (ValueAdd VC, Oct 15, 2026; Gate.com, Oct 15, 2026)
- Named investors reported for the Series H were **Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, Capital Group, Coatue, and D1 Capital Partners**; the available source labels them as co-leads but does not provide an Anthropic filing or company release in the requested window. [report] (ValueAdd VC, Oct 15, 2026)
- Anthropic was reported to have committed **at least $518 billion over 10 years** to cloud, compute, and infrastructure, with spending involving Google and Amazon; the available report does not identify a confirmed Series H closing document or a complete contract schedule. [report] (Resultsense, Oct 15, 2026)

## GOOGL [Ownership / valuation]

- Alphabet was reported to own **about 14% of Anthropic**, with its stake capped at **15%**; the available source does not provide a confirmed post-Series-H cap-table percentage or an Alphabet filing published during the requested window. [report] (Marcus Today, Oct 15, 2026)
- A **$965 billion** Anthropic post-money valuation would imply an approximate gross equity value of **$135.1 billion** for a 14% Alphabet stake and **$144.75 billion** for a 15% stake, before accounting for preferred-share terms, dilution, accounting adjustments, or carrying-value rules. [report] (Marcus Today, Oct 15, 2026)
- No available October 15–16 report provides a confirmed Alphabet balance-sheet carrying value for Anthropic or quantifies the Series H dilution effect on Alphabet’s reported investment. (Available sources, Oct 15, 2026)

## AMZN [Ownership / valuation]

- Amazon was reported to own **15%–21% of Anthropic on a non-voting basis**, but the available source describes the range as an estimate rather than a confirmed post-Series-H ownership percentage. [report] (Marcus Today, Oct 15, 2026)
- A **$965 billion** Anthropic post-money valuation would imply an approximate gross equity value of **$144.75 billion–$202.65 billion** for a 15%–21% stake, before preferred-share terms, dilution, accounting adjustments, or carrying-value rules. [report] (Marcus Today, Oct 15, 2026)
- No available October 15–16 report provides a confirmed Amazon balance-sheet carrying value for Anthropic or quantifies the Series H dilution effect on Amazon’s reported investment. (Available sources, Oct 15, 2026)

## MSFT [Read-through]

- The available October 15 reports identify **Google and Amazon**, not Microsoft, as Anthropic investors and cloud providers; no specific Microsoft share-price move, analyst rating change, price-target change, or Anthropic-related Microsoft estimate was provided. (Available sources, Oct 15, 2026)

## NVDA [Read-through]

- The available October 15 reports do not provide a specific Nvidia share-price move, analyst rating change, price-target change, or Anthropic-related Nvidia estimate. (Available sources, Oct 15, 2026)

## SpaceX Colossus 1 [Compute capacity]

- Anthropic was reported in May 2026 to have agreed to use the **full computing capacity of SpaceX’s Colossus 1 facility in Memphis**, adding **300 megawatts** of capacity. [report] (Economic Times, Oct 14, 2026)
- The available report does not confirm Anthropic’s securing of **more than 220,000 GPUs**, and it does not disclose a contract duration, pricing, take-or-pay provision, termination terms, or a company-confirmed Colossus 1 agreement published between October 15, 2026 and 02:03 ET on October 16, 2026. (Available sources, Oct 15, 2026)
